notes.title: Version 1.3: France localization!
notes.notes:
We're two bilingual developers from Quebec, so we released Quest Giver in both English and French. However as more players popped up in France, it was made clear to us that Quebecois French and France French are substantially different, and that much of the slang and expressions we used just don't work for our European NPCs!

So now, we're pleased to announce a new language option: France French ːsteamthumbsupː
Those who already play in French will be prompted once to pick their new localization of choice:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/7295caf518b27e23e6b46d9f93bb06cdd5426337.png


We're super grateful to  Heksaeder who volunteered to go over the 2000+ lines of dialogue and Franced them up for us (while also catching numerous typos we'd missed), this wouldn't have been possible without you! We also adjusted the punctuation in the France version, using the proper quotation marks and spacing:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/6d121ceb5ccce0e15e3bee27ad690534026a8a30.png

Between the huge rewrite and the small presentation details, we hope this version of Quest Giver is more comfy for everyone. Now get to work!

notes.title: Version 1.2.2: Fancy text & minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey folks, just some quick bug fixes:

 Fixed several UI input bugs (including one submitted by TheChronicleHunter, thanks!)
 Fixed an incorrect note in one of the scenario songs
 Fixed an unlikely but devastating crash in the music engine

Plus we've dotted some cool text effects around the game for special dialogue:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/4b8724c282964b77d9c21d920fb8d8bca21e860b.gif

That's it for now, but we've got something fun coming down the pipeline, to be announced soon!

notes.title: Version 1.2: SFX, QoL, and a Discord Server!
notes.notes:
We’ve just launched our Discord server! Hop in to chat about Quest Giver and get a sneak peak at our next project 🤫

 New sound effects, especially during the end of day results

notes.title: Version 1.1.1: Small clarity update + bug & crash fixes
notes.notes:
There's a nice little update for all you NPCs today:

 Set the default font to CURVY for new players (since people find it easier to read, and by golly QG is a readin' game)
 Fixed a crash in The World Needs a Hero if Krol is killed early and the goblin quest is ignored, thanks to Kerolink for finding and reporting it! ːsteamthumbsupː
 Fixed some French and English typos
 Added a more noticeable scroll for important quest results:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/92557eda6b75c937fe6776521485bfce611b06a9.png

In other news: we're up to nearly 17 000 global quests succeeded, well done everyone!

See you at the next update 💖
-Darzington & Zalinius

notes.title: Version 1.1: QoL, typos, and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Just a few quality-of-life and bugfix changes:

-The scenario map is now more intuitive for mouse-users (the current scenario button always spins, and there’s a text hint for how to exit the map)
-Pressing keyboard buttons like volume or media controls no longer puts you into keyboard input mode
-Fixed some typos
-Fixed some missing french text

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/47d3cad234e752c2f1ffeb673318768e8b51fa4a.gif

📜As always, feel free to submit a bug or feedback, we appreciate it.
Happy quest giving, NPCs! 💖
